  fp_status_word_from_exception_mask = __acrt_fenv_get_fp_status_word_from_exception_mask(SetFlags);
  v6 = fp_status_word_from_exception_mask & *Except | v4 & ~fp_status_word_from_exception_mask;
  _setfpstatusword(v6);
  return fetestexcept(v6 & 0x1F) != (v6 & 0x1F);
}
// ENDFUNC
// FUNC 1007176a _fetestexcept
int __cdecl fetestexcept(int Flags)
{
  fexcept_t Except; // [esp+0h] [ebp-4h] BYREF

  Except = 0;
  fegetexceptflag(&Except, Flags);
  return Except & 0x1F;
}
